summary: Independently root-caused Phase 146H.1's disclosed, out-of-scope CONFIRMATION_UNBOUND Blocking finding, without assuming any prior phase's conclusion. Reproduced the failure from scratch (not from 146H.1's own evidence) by constructing a genuine four-artifact bundle with the real production function build_publication_record (Phase 146G) and verifying it with the real production CLI (pcae governance-record verify --related), independently observing CONFIRMATION_UNBOUND. Traced the root cause directly: governance/verification.py's confirmation_binding check (_confirmable_content_digest_of, introduced Phase 143E, never modified since except 146H.1's unrelated schema_version fix) compares human_confirmation_evidence.confirmed_content_digest against a digest recomputed over the human_governance_record's own stripped fields -- the original 143E design. CHGR-REQ-201 (frozen Phase 146B, independently verified 146C) instead requires confirmed_content_digest to be populated verbatim from PublicationReadinessPackage.preview_digest, a digest computed by interactive_workflow.preview.builder.PreviewBuilder over a structurally different document (the Preview object). record.py (Phase 146G) correctly implements CHGR-REQ-201 (independently re-confirmed by direct execution, not merely re-read from 146H's claim). The contract itself (CHGR-REQ-201, CHGR-REQ-085, CHGR-001 SS10) contains no reference at all to confirmation_binding/CONFIRMATION_UNBOUND/confirmable_content -- that check is a pure implementation artifact, never promoted into or reconciled with contract text. The human_confirmation_evidence.schema.json field description for confirmed_content_digest is itself internally self-contradictory (sentence 1 matches CHGR-REQ-085; sentence 2 documents the verifier's stale behavior) and unrevised since Phase 143E (git log --follow: single commit). Classified Resolution A: verification implementation defect, no contract issue exists, implementation repair recommended. Existing tests never caught this because every test supplying related siblings to verify_artifact_at_path uses 143E-era hand-authored fixtures built to satisfy the stale check by construction, never a genuinely 146G-constructed bundle. No repair performed (investigation-only phase, per Human Authorization and No-Go Boundary): no contract, schema, verifier, or Publication Coordinator file modified. Full evidence, digest tracing, architectural analysis, and authority analysis in docs/PHASE_146H2_CONFIRMATION_BINDING_ROOT_CAUSE_RESOLUTION.md. Verdict: ROOT CAUSE ESTABLISHED. Recommends 146H.3 -- Confirmation Binding Verification Repair, narrowly authorized to reconcile governance/verification.py's confirmation_binding check (and the associated stale schema field description) with CHGR-REQ-201's already-frozen construction rule.
tests_added_or_updated: None added or modified (investigation-only phase; no source or test file was changed). Independent reproduction was performed via direct, one-off script execution against the real production construction function (build_publication_record) and the real production CLI verification path (pcae governance-record verify --related), not by adding a persisted test.
